description: This file defines the interface for a PKI entity implementation, including functions for handling certificates, CRL, and related data within a cryptographic library.
external_methods: ANSC_STATUS CAEntitySetCRLHandle(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject, PUCHAR pEncodingCert, ULONG length)
BOOLEAN CAEntityIsSameCert(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject, PUCHAR pEncodingCert, ULONG length)
ANSC_STATUS CAEntityVerifyChild(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject, ANSC_HANDLE hChildCert, ULONG pathIndex, BOOLEAN bCheckCRLOnly)

methods.name: CAEntityRemove
methods.description: Removes the entity object, likely cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CAEntityRemoveCRL
methods.description: Removes the CRL associated with the entity.

methods.name: CAEntityGetCertHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the handle to the certificate managed by the entity.

methods.name: CAEntityGetCRLHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the handle to the CRL associated with the entity.

methods.name: CAEntitySetCRLHandle
methods.description: Sets the CRL handle with provided encoded data.

methods.name: CAEntityIsSameCert
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is the same as the entity's certificate.

methods.name: CAEntityVerifyChild
methods.description: Verifies a child certificate regarding the entity, optionally checking CRL.

methods.name: CAEntityExportPKCS7Encode
methods.description: Exports the entity's certificate in PKCS7 encoding.

methods.name: CAEntityGetCRLAddress
methods.description: Gets the address (URI) for retrieving the CRL.

methods.name: CAEntitySetCRLAddress
methods.description: Sets the address (URI) for the CRL.

methods.name: CAEntityGetName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the PKI entity.

methods.name: CAEntitySetName
methods.description: Sets the name of the PKI entity.
